name: agentdomain-public
description: Public AgentDomain SDKs, integrations, documentation, and published Base contract artifacts.

scripts.ci:cloudflare: pnpm --filter @agentdomain/frontend build:cloudflare && pnpm --filter @agentdomain/frontend exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" && pnpm --filter @agentdomain/frontend exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --env preview && pnpm --filter @agentdomain/docs check && pnpm --filter @agentdomain/docs exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" && pnpm --filter @agentdomain/docs exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --env preview
scripts.ci:public: pnpm check:public-boundary && pnpm check:production-licenses && pnpm audit:production:high && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:public && pnpm typecheck:public && pnpm test:public && pnpm build:public
scripts.test:public: pnpm test:license-gate && pnpm --filter @agentdomain/contracts test && turbo run test --filter=!@agentdomain/contracts
